## s04-v10 — argument map

*svecchayaiva bhagavan nijamārge kāritaḥ padam.* By Your will alone, Lord, I was made to step on Your own path — then why do I behave just like a man, knowing nothing fit for Your feet? Placed unasked (Lakshmanjoo's stressed point: "I never asked You... You have done it Yourself!"), yet behaving humanly — the complaint of the carried.
